The '''Draboon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draboon/Legends|Draboon]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Venom-mite/Legends|venom-mites]].<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Draboon system was established in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]], which placed the system in grid square O-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
